#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 998244353LL;
const int MAXF = 200000;

vector<ll> fac(MAXF + 1);

ll power(ll x, ll y, ll m) {
    if (y < 0) return 0LL;
    ll ans = 1;
    x %= m;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y & 1) ans = (ans * x) % m;
        y >>= 1;
        x = (x * x) % m;
    }
    return ans;
}

ll choose(int n, int k) {
    if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0LL;
    ll den = (fac[k] * fac[n - k]) % MOD;
    ll denInv = power(den, MOD - 2, MOD);
    return (fac[n] * denInv) % MOD;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    ll N, K;
    cin >> N >> K;

    if (K >= N) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    int C = (int)(N - K);

    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= MAXF; i++) {
        fac[i] = (i * fac[i - 1]) % MOD;
    }

    ll ans = 0;
    int sign = 1;
    for (int i = C; i > 0; i--) {
        ll val = (choose(C, i) * power(i, N, MOD)) % MOD;
        ll term = (sign == 1) ? val : (MOD - val);
        ans = (ans + term) % MOD;
        sign = -sign;
    }

    ll mult = (2 * choose(N, C)) % MOD;
    if (C == N) mult = 1LL;
    cout << (ans * mult) % MOD << "\n";

    return 0;
}
